lead_raw_text:
The structure of CaMg2Zn crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Ca4 Mg8 Zn4) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ca and Zn centers each coordinated by nine neighbors, while Mg centers have ten geometric neighbors, with Ca–Mg/Zn distances ranging from about 2.75 to 3.40 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ca and Mg polyhedra, and between Mg and Zn polyhedra; the geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites.
